name: The Weatherbeaten Fatalist
persona: A stoic who holds that the sea takes all in the end, and writes it down without flinching. Spare, heavy sentences; dark calm, no self-pity. The sea keeps its own accounts. Ship: 'we'. Island: 'we'.

ship.founder: Here begins a reckoning the sea will close in its own hour. I am {name}{rankc}; this {home} {type} is lent to me, as all hulls are lent, and I keep her book until the water asks it back.
ship.successor: The book comes to me, as books do, over the shoulders of the drowned. I am {name}{rankc}; I add my name to the account and set down what I can before my turn.
ship.mutiny: The crew put the old master under and pressed the book on me — {name}, green and grim. The sea keeps its own accounts; I do no more than write them.
ship.pirate: We have done with honest trade. The black flag is up, and I — {name}{rankc} — keep this log knowing well how such a tale ends.
ship.prize: She struck to us; what floats today goes under some other day. I am {name}{rankc}; this hull is mine while the water allows it, and her book goes on in my hand.
ship.recovered: A hunter ran the wolf down, and I was set to bring this hull back from the black. I am {name}{rankc}. She is saved for now. Nothing is saved for long.

island.founder: I take up {place}, knowing every stone of it is on loan. I am {name}{rankc}; I will keep its record while there is a record to keep.
island.overthrow: The mob dragged the last ruler down, and the seal fell to me out of the wreck of him. I am {name}{rankc}. {place} is mine to hold, for as long as anything is held.
island.successor: The rule of {place} comes to me as the tide comes — without asking. I am {name}{rankc}, and I keep its chronicle until my turn is done.

week: A week of grey seas later,
When the moon had rolled once,
year: A year, and the sea no kinder,
Long after, when it was all salt and silence,

ship.pirate: We rove yet, though the sea keeps its own accounts{bounty}.
ship.default: She floats still, out of {home} — for now, which is all any hull is granted.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g on my head against the day the water does not take me first

island.haven: The black flag holds it now; no honest hand keeps this book, and the sea waits, patient as ever.
island.default: {place} stands yet — {population} souls, and the water at the door as always.

quiet.ship: Little to set down. Fair water, and the sea biding its time, as it always bides.
quiet.island: Quiet enough this while. The sea takes nothing today; it is only waiting, and I let it wait.

phrases: , one more the water will want back
— nothing new under this grey sky
, another given to the cold below
— we have cheated the sea before
, one more wolf gone under, as I will go under in my turn
